dilme.title: Coil Slitting Lines
dilme.desc: Complete lines that slit wide coils into strips to your exact widths: every unit from decoiler to recoiler is built at the Servosteel facility, factory-tested and commissioned turnkey on site.

highlights.title: Many strips from one coil
highlights.text: The wide master coil is slit into multiple strips at once, to your order sizes — reducing scrap and stock costs.

highlights.title: Strip width precision
highlights.text: Precise knife setup and controlled tension recoiling keep strip widths within tight tolerances.

highlights.title: Sized to your capacity
highlights.text: Light and heavy-duty frame options for coil weights from 1.5 to 15 tonnes.

highlights.title: Schneider control architecture
highlights.text: Lexium and Altivar based speed control; the whole line is run from a single operator panel.

dilme.tableNote: The values above are standard series; coil width, number of strips and line speed are sized to your project.
dilme.ctaText: Send us your coil weight, sheet thickness and strip widths; we'll define the right series and line layout together.

boykesme.metaDesc: Cut-to-length lines: precision cutting from coil to sheet. Straightening, servo feeding, guillotine and stacking managed by a single PLC. Schneider control systems.
boykesme.title: Cut-to-Length Lines
boykesme.desc: Complete lines that turn coils into sheets at exactly the length you need: straightening, servo feeding, guillotine and stacking — all built in our facility and managed by a single PLC.

highlights.title: Length accuracy
highlights.text: Servo feeding and encoder measurement cut sheet lengths within tight tolerances, with repeatability in serial production.

highlights.title: Clean cutting
highlights.text: The guillotine blade gap is set to the sheet thickness for burr-free, distortion-free cuts.

highlights.title: Single-point control
highlights.text: The whole line is managed from one operator panel via PLC; lengths, quantities and recipes are stored on the HMI.

highlights.title: Surface protection
highlights.text: An optional PVC film application unit protects sensitive sheet surfaces from scratches before stacking.

paras: Every unit, from the first link of the line to the final stack, comes from a single manufacturer: decoiler, straightener, feeder, shear and stacker are sized to each other. Compatibility problems seen in lines assembled from multiple suppliers are eliminated from the start.
Speed control uses Schneider Lexium and Altivar series drives; the line is fully assembled and tested at our factory before shipment, which keeps on-site commissioning short.
The line configuration is engineered to your sheet thickness, coil weight and sheet dimensions; if needed, it can be combined with a slitting unit to produce both strips and sheets.
boykesme.ctaText: Send us your sheet thickness, coil weight and sheet dimensions; we'll come back with a line layout and a technical offer.

about.storyTitle: From single machines to complete lines
story: Servosteel was founded when a group of young engineers set out to build cost-effective and easy-to-control press feeding systems. We started with decoilers, straighteners and servo feeders; field experience gradually grew into complete line engineering — today we install coil slitting, cut-to-length and roll forming lines turnkey.

What sets us apart is that every link of the line is produced under one roof: mechanical design, manufacturing, automation software and commissioning are all in the same team. Our customers work with a single partner, and the line components arrive perfectly matched.
Lines built at our facility in Sancaktepe, Istanbul are producing today in more than 48 countries — across Europe, the Middle East, Africa and the Far East.
about.visionText: To be a strong Turkish brand preferred worldwide in coil forming and processing technologies, through custom engineering, reliable automation and a sustainable production approach.
missionText: At ServoSTEEL, in roll forming, cut-to-length, slitting, press feeding and automatic stacking systems — and in the design and manufacture of the dies these lines require — we analyse our customers' production needs accurately and develop high-precision, efficient, reliable and long-life solutions.

By combining our technological know-how with our field experience, we offer complete production lines and custom die solutions that increase production capacity, ensure consistent quality, are easy to operate and maintain, and help reduce operating costs.

From machine and die design through manufacturing, automation, installation and commissioning, we work in close cooperation with our customers at every stage; with our after-sales support, our commitment to continuous improvement and our attention to resource efficiency, we create long-term value.

kablo-kanali.name: Cable Tray Production Line
kablo-kanali.short: A complete line for perforated and solid cable trays, ladders and covers.
kablo-kanali.hero: A complete roll forming line producing cable trays — the backbone of electrical infrastructure — from coil to finished product: decoiler, straightener, servo feeder, punching stations, roll forming machine and cutting unit are managed by a single PLC.
kablo-kanali.meta: Cable tray production line: a complete custom roll forming solution for perforated/solid trays, ladders and cover profiles.

features.title: In-line punching
features.text: Ventilation and mounting holes are punched by servo punching stations on the line — no separate operation needed.

features.title: Fast size changeover
features.text: Recipe-based switching between different tray widths keeps setup times to a minimum.

features.title: Galvanized-sheet friendly
features.text: Rolls are machined and hardened to avoid damaging the zinc coating (4140 steel, 58-60 HRC).

solar-profil.name: Solar Profile Production Line
solar-profil.short: A high-speed roll forming solution for PV mounting profiles.
solar-profil.hero: A line producing hat, C and Omega profiles for solar power plant mounting structures directly from coil; punching stations open the mounting holes in-line, so profiles arrive on site ready to install.
solar-profil.meta: Solar mounting profile production line: a complete, high-speed roll forming line with punching stations for PV structure profiles.

features.title: Profile form to your project
features.text: Roll tooling is designed for hat, C, U or Omega sections according to the EPC's structural design.

features.title: Suitable for Magnelis® and galvanized
features.text: High-corrosion-resistant coated sheets are formed with roll surfaces that protect the coating.

features.title: Length and hole recipes
features.text: Hole patterns and lengths for different table types are selected as recipes on the HMI.

agir-raf.name: Storage Rack Production Line
agir-raf.short: A punching-station line for rack uprights and beam profiles.
agir-raf.hero: A line producing the load-bearing rack uprights and beams of logistics warehouses; multi-row mounting holes are punched in-line by servo punches, and dimensional stability is maintained even in thick sheet.
agir-raf.meta: Storage rack production line: a custom roll forming solution with punching stations for rack uprights and beam profiles.

features.title: Multi-row punching
features.text: The hook holes of upright profiles are punched by servo stations without slowing the line down.

features.title: Thick sheet capability
features.text: Frame and roll sizing suited to the high wall thicknesses racking systems demand.

features.title: Dimensional repeatability
features.text: Servo feeding and encoder control keep hole-to-hole precision in serial production.

iskele-kalas.name: Scaffolding Plank Production Line
iskele-kalas.short: Production of anti-slip scaffolding platforms and plank profiles.
iskele-kalas.hero: A line producing the steel walking platforms of construction scaffolding; anti-slip surface embossing and drainage holes are formed in-line, and a press station for hook-end forming can be integrated.
iskele-kalas.meta: Scaffolding plank production line: a complete roll forming line for anti-slip steel platform and plank profiles.

features.title: Anti-slip surface forming
features.text: Diamond/knurl embossing is pressed continuously in the roll forming stations.

features.title: Drainage and lightening holes
features.text: Hole patterns are punched in-line; the platform gets lighter and safer at once.

features.title: End-processing integration
features.text: A press/station for hook bending and end trimming can be integrated at the end of the line.

yol-bariyeri.name: Guardrail Production Line
yol-bariyeri.short: A heavy-duty roll forming line for W-beam guardrail profiles.
yol-bariyeri.hero: A heavy-duty line producing W-beam (two-wave) and three-wave guardrail profiles — the standard of road safety; it forms the wave profile in thick galvanized sheet with standard-compliant precision.
yol-bariyeri.meta: Guardrail production line: a heavy-duty roll forming solution for W-beam and three-wave highway barrier profiles.

features.title: Standard-compliant forming
features.text: Roll tooling design and form control for barrier geometries within EN 1317.

features.title: Heavy frame structure
features.text: A rigid body and strong drive keep 3-4 mm galvanized sheet running true even in the wave form.

features.title: Hole and length precision
features.text: Connection holes and cut lengths are fixed under servo control; on-site assembly is trouble-free.

gurultu-bariyeri.name: Noise Barrier Production Line
gurultu-bariyeri.short: A roll forming line for sound barrier cassette and panel profiles.
gurultu-bariyeri.hero: A line producing the aluminium/steel cassette profiles of noise barriers along highways and railways; perforated front (absorber) and closed back panels can be produced on the same line platform.
gurultu-bariyeri.meta: Noise barrier production line: a roll forming solution producing perforated and solid sound barrier cassette and panel profiles.

features.title: Perforated panel production
features.text: Front-face perforation for acoustic absorption is integrated in-line or before feeding.

features.title: Aluminium and steel compatibility
features.text: Roll pressure settings for different materials and thicknesses are managed with recipes.

features.title: Long panel capability
features.text: Precise cut-to-length and safe stacking for barrier module lengths.

c-sigma-omega.name: C+ / Sigma / Omega Profile Line
c-sigma-omega.short: Light steel framing profiles: multiple sections on one line.
c-sigma-omega.hero: A flexible solution producing C, Sigma and Omega profiles — the load-bearers of light steel structures — on a single line; changeover between sections takes minutes thanks to adjustable roll groups and the recipe system.
c-sigma-omega.meta: C, Sigma and Omega profile production line: an adjustable, multi-section roll forming solution for light steel framing profiles.

features.title: Three sections on one line
features.text: C, Sigma and Omega forms are produced on the same line with adjustable stations, lowering the investment cost.

features.title: Automatic width/height adjustment
features.text: Profile size changes are made via servo axes with HMI recipes.

features.title: Structural hole patterns
features.text: Bolt holes and service holes are punched in-line according to the project.

rulo-acicilar.name: Decoilers
rulo-acicilar.short: Hydraulic 6-20 t and mechanical 500-2,500 kg decoiling solutions.
rulo-acicilar.hero: The first link of every line: hydraulic and mechanical decoilers that carry the coil safely and pay it off under controlled tension. Engineered to your capacity, sheet width and automation level.
rulo-acicilar.meta: Hydraulic (6-20 t) and mechanical (500-2,500 kg) decoilers: custom solutions for press feeding and coil processing lines.

features.title: Hydraulic mandrel expansion
features.text: On heavy-duty series the coil inner diameter is clamped hydraulically; loading is fast and safe.

features.title: Loading car option
features.text: A hydraulic loading car can be added so heavy coils reach the line without waiting for a crane.

features.title: Line synchronisation
features.text: With dancer arm / photocell control, the decoiler automatically matches the line speed.

servo-suruculer.name: Servo Feeders
servo-suruculer.short: Precise step feeding into press lines; standard and mini series.
servo-suruculer.hero: Servo feeders advance the sheet into the die in millimetric steps; Schneider Lexium servo technology delivers high repeatability, press synchronisation and easy recipe management.
servo-suruculer.meta: Servo feeders: standard and mini series for press feeding lines, Schneider Lexium based precise sheet feeding.

features.title: Millimetric step precision
features.text: The servo motor + precision gearbox combination keeps step tolerances in serial production.

features.title: Press synchronisation
features.text: Fully synchronous operation with the press cam signal; pilot release function is standard.

features.title: Easy operation
features.text: Step length, speed and ramp values are stored as recipes on the touch HMI.

dogrultmali-servo-suruculer.name: Straightener Servo Feeders
dogrultmali-servo-suruculer.short: Straightening and servo feeding in one body: saves space and investment.
dogrultmali-servo-suruculer.hero: A compact solution combining straightening rolls that remove coil-set memory with servo feeding in a single body; it eliminates the separate straightener investment and its floor space.
dogrultmali-servo-suruculer.meta: Straightener servo feeders: straightening + precise feeding in one machine. A compact solution for press lines with cabinet and mini options.

features.title: Two operations, one machine
features.text: Straightening and feeding in the same body; the line gets shorter and installation simpler.

features.title: Adjustable straightening pressure
features.text: Roll pressures are steplessly adjusted to the sheet thickness.

features.title: Cabinet and mini options
features.text: Cabinet (heavy) or mini series is chosen by sheet width and thickness.

kompakt-hatlar.name: Compact Lines
kompakt-hatlar.short: Decoiler + straightener + feeder on one platform: the tight-space solution.
kompakt-hatlar.hero: Compact lines combine decoiling, straightening and servo feeding on a single platform; designed for businesses that want full-featured press feeding in limited space.
kompakt-hatlar.meta: Compact press feeding lines: decoiler, straightener and servo feeder on one platform. A complete solution for tight spaces.

features.title: Minimum floor space
features.text: The work of three machines on one chassis; serious space savings versus a classic line layout.

features.title: Single-point control
features.text: Decoiler, straightener and feeder are managed from one HMI; operator workload drops.

features.title: Fast commissioning
features.text: A factory-tested single body; on-site installation and commissioning take little time.

kalip-ve-merdane.name: Tooling and Roll Sets
kalip-ve-merdane.short: Roll forming tooling and press dies: die design and manufacture for your lines.
kalip-ve-merdane.hero: What a line produces is decided by the tooling, not the machines. Servosteel designs and manufactures both its roll forming tooling and its press dies in-house; the tooling is engineered together with the line itself.
kalip-ve-merdane.meta: Roll forming tooling and progressive press die manufacturing: designed to your drawing, 4140 alloy steel rolls hardened to 58-60 HRC. Line and tooling from one manufacturer.

features.title: Engineered with the line
features.text: Tooling and rolls are designed under the same roof as the machine, so there is never a mismatch between line and tooling.

features.title: Hardened rolls
features.text: Rolls are produced from 4140 alloy steel and hardened to 58-60 HRC, holding dimensional stability in series production.

features.title: Progressive press dies
features.text: Design and manufacture of progressive press dies for sheet metal parts. A progressive die demands precise pitch feeding — because we build both the die and the feeding line, pitch tolerance and die match are set from the start.

features.title: Built to your drawing
features.text: Not a catalogue section: the roll set or die is designed from the drawing you send — custom sections included.
